# Clinical Trial Diversity Studio

> Search ClinicalTrials.gov in plain language, compare trials side by side, and view trial site geography with statewide US Census ACS population context.

Clinical Trial Diversity Studio is an independent demo built on the public U.S. National Library of Medicine ClinicalTrials.gov registry. It does not provide medical advice and is not designed to collect or store protected health information.

## Live functionality

- Plain-language search across live ClinicalTrials.gov records
- Semantic reranking of registry candidates
- Source-grounded explanations tied to ClinicalTrials.gov fields, with links to each record
- Trial comparison of 2 to 4 trials using registry fields
- Trial site geography by state and region from reported facility locations
- Statewide US Census ACS population context, shown separately from trial enrollment
- Optional AI document review against listed eligibility criteria, with clear limitations; not a medical determination
